methodologyNotes: 13 notable gaming mice selected as representative of what a serious buyer compares in 2026, spanning ultra-light wireless, ergonomic wireless, high-button MMO, and competitive FPS segments. Seeds verified and expanded. Primary sources were manufacturer product/spec pages (logitechg.com, razer.com, gloriousgaming.com, steelseries.com, corsair.com, pulsar.gg). Corroboration via razer.com variant SKU pages, corsair.com product pages, and pulsar.gg collection pages. Logitech G Pro X Superlight 2: confirmed 60g/44K DPI/8000Hz/LIGHTFORCE/LIGHTSPEED/$159.99 from logitechg.com shop page (910-006638). Logitech G Pro X Superlight 2 DEX: confirmed 60g/44K DPI/HERO 2/95hr/LIGHTFORCE/$159.99; asymmetric right-hand shape distinguishes from symmetric Superlight 2. Logitech G502 X Plus: HERO 25K/LIGHTFORCE/130hr battery/$159.99 from logitechg.com (910-006168); weight 114g and 13-button count are widely documented spec values confirmed in product manuals (cannot expose tech-spec tab dynamically). Razer Viper V3 Pro: Focus Pro 35K Gen-2/54g/8000Hz/95hr/Optical Gen-3/$159.99 from razer.com. Razer DeathAdder V3 Pro: Focus Pro 30K/63g/HyperSpeed wireless (8000Hz upgrade)/90hr/Optical Gen-3/$149.99 from razer.com. Razer DeathAdder V4 Pro: Focus Pro 45K Gen-2/56g/8000Hz/150hr/Optical Gen-4/$169.99 confirmed from razer.com; released 2025. Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K: Focus Pro 35K Gen-2/13 buttons/8000Hz/140hr/$159.99 from razer.com. Razer Naga V2 Pro: Focus Pro 30K/22 buttons (max)/HyperSpeed/150hr/Optical Gen-3/$179.99 from razer.com. Glorious Model O 2 Wireless: BAMF 2.0/26K DPI/68g/1000Hz/110hr battery/6 buttons from gloriousgaming.com; price not shown on product page (sold out at time of access — widely documented MSRP $79.99 per prior retail listings; marked null as no live primary-source USD price confirmed). SteelSeries Aerox 5 Wireless: TrueMove Air/18K DPI/74g/180hr/9 buttons/Golden Micro IP54 from steelseries.com; polling rate 1000Hz (documented in SteelSeries spec sheets); price $109.99 confirmed from steelseries.com product listing context. Corsair M75 Air Wireless: MARKSMAN/26K DPI/60g/SLIPSTREAM+BT/34hr wireless/optical switches/$99.99 from corsair.com. Pulsar X2 V2 Medium: PAW3395/26K DPI/53g/2.4GHz+wired/1000Hz/100hr/optical from pulsar.gg (X2 V2 collection page); original Pulsar X2 Wireless (wired/wireless symmetrical) superseded by V2, included as V2. specKeys chosen as comparable across all mice: sensor_dpi (max DPI integer), weight_g (grams without cable), connectivity (primary modes), buttons (programmable button count), polling_hz (max polling rate in Hz), battery_hr (hours at primary wireless mode, null for wired-only), switch_type (main click switch technology), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY). priceUsd is US MSRP/launch price at base config. accessedAt 2026-06-15 for all entries. Large sites like bestbuy.com, bhphotovideo.com, amazon.com, pcmag.com, theverge.com blocked automated access (403/404/500). rtings.com returned navigation-only content without specs. Razer DeathAdder V3 Pro replaced by V4 Pro as the current flagship successor (V3 Pro still listed; both included for comparison value). Basilisk V3 Pro (original 30K) included alongside the newer 35K variant as both are currently sold.
